title: Halogen-confining host materials for high-performance zinc–halogen batteries
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,8636-8724
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00846H, Review Article
Shude Liu, Xue Peng, Yafei Chai, Ming Ma, Huilin Zhang, Jieming Chen, Ling Kang, Bin Ding, Yusuke Yamauchi, Seong Chan Jun
A confinement–catalysis–conduction triad is proposed to guide the rational design of these materials, with an in-depth exploration of structure–performance relationships and mechanistic insights across various zinc–halogen batteries.
